title: Courtesy Credit on Lienholder Refund Releases
content:
**Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda — service recovery schedule: courtesy credit on refunds released to the lienholder**

A courtesy credit is added to a refund released to the lienholder according to how long before the release date the holder's signed request was recorded. The signed request read is the waiver's completed cancellation request, and the date taken is the date the request was recorded.

The refund payment period used below is 30 calendar days in every tier of the Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda (Kessler GAP Waiver 125, Kessler GAP Used Vehicle 140, Kessler GAP Waiver 150, Kessler GAP Plus 150, Kessler GAP Plus 175 and Kessler GAP Commercial 130).

| Signed request recorded before the release date | Courtesy credit added to the release |
|---|---|
| More than the refund payment period (31 days or more) | 25.00 |
| 15 to 30 days (15 to the refund payment period) | 10.00 |
| Within 14 days | None |
| No completed cancellation request on file | None |

The courtesy credit is a flat amount. It is added to the release after the late-release interest has been rounded to the cent, and the release total is then rounded half up to the cent.

### Boundary cases (days counted from the recording date as day 0 to the release date)

- Recorded 14 days before release: no credit. Recorded 15 days before: 10.00.
- Recorded 30 days before: 10.00. Recorded 31 days before: 25.00.

### Basis Q&A

**Which request counts where a waiver has several requests?** The completed cancellation request; a request still submitted or declined is not the signed request this schedule reads.

**Is the credit added to a refund due of 0.00?** No release is made for a refund due of 0.00, so no credit arises.
